bio.introduction: Fullstack Engineer/Web Developer with 20 years experience local to the Maryland, District of Columbia, and Virginia Metropolitan area. My initial experience in the defense space as a government contractor spanned backend and frontend technology from C++ & JAVA to LAMP stack applications. I have more recently worked with on Javascript/Node/Kotlin development and more fullstack projects in the fintech startup domain. Along the way I have experience with React, Angular, Ext.js and a number of other frameworks. I am currently self-employed developing websites for small businesses. As those projects come to a close I am looking to take on a new full time work, to increase my skills as a Web Developer and join a great team. I am looking for an opportunity to make software that is resilient, useful, great and sometimes pretty. I am open to relocation and remote positions.
